name: io.github.tonyyang0504/etsy-ecommerce-channels-mcp
description: Etsy (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, mark_shipped, create_listing, update_listing, end_listin

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Etsy App API Key keystring (etsy.com/developers/your-apps); sent as client_id in the refresh grant form body (Etsy's refresh grant takes no client secret).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Value of the x-api-key header required on every v3 request: the keystring and the shared secret joined by a colon, e.g. 1aa2bb33c44d55eeeeee6fff:a1b2c3d4e5 (both on the Your Apps page).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token (numeric user id prefix, e.g. 12345678.JNGI...) from a one-time OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE consent at etsy.com/oauth/connect with scopes shops_r listings_r listings_w transactions_r transactions_w; valid 90 days, after which the seller consents again. Access tokens (1 h) are minted from it. A refresh grant also returns a new refresh token, which replaces the old one. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_SHOP_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Etsy shop id (GET /v3/application/users/me returns it as shop_id).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_TAXONOMY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Seller taxonomy id every created listing is filed under (GET /v3/application/seller-taxonomy/nodes); required by create_listing.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_WHO_MADE
environmentVariables.description: createDraftListing who_made for new listings: i_did | someone_else | collective; required by create_listing.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_WHEN_MADE
environmentVariables.description: createDraftListing when_made for new listings, e.g. made_to_order, 2020_2026, 2010_2019, before_2007; required by create_listing.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_SHIPPING_PROFILE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Shipping profile id for new physical listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/shipping-profiles); required for physical listings.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_READINESS_STATE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Processing profile id for new physical listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/readiness-state-definitions); required for physical listings.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_RETURN_POLICY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional return policy id for new listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/policies/return).
